title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
subtitle: A language model that looks things up in your documents before it answers.

ingest.label: A  /  INDEX YOUR KNOWLEDGE  /  DONE AHEAD OF TIME

query.label: B  /  ANSWER A QUESTION  /  EVERY TIME SOMEONE ASKS

stages.title: Chunk
stages.desc: Split into passages; keep each source ID

stages.title: Embed
stages.desc: A model turns each chunk into a vector

stages.title: Vector store
stages.desc: Vectors, chunk text and source IDs

stages.title: Augment
stages.desc: Question plus retrieved chunks and IDs

stages.title: Generate
stages.desc: Answers using only the given context

edges.question: the original question travels with the retrieved context

stored.title: WHAT GETS STORED
stored.body: Each chunk is saved three ways: its text, its embedding vector, and the ID of the source it came from.

why.title: WHY RETRIEVE FIRST
why.body: The model answers from your documents, not only from its training, and can point to where each fact came from.

how.title: HOW RETRIEVAL WORKS
how.body: The question becomes a vector. The store returns the k chunks whose vectors sit nearest to it; k is a setting you choose.

disclaimer: Conceptual diagram: real systems differ in chunk size, embedding model, store and ranking. Icons are hand-drawn vector art; no images were generated.
